Hey guys, it's Kai. Quick update about Saturday. The forecast for Trigg is two meters with a strong onshore wind, so that's too big and too messy for most of us. Forget it. We're going south instead, to the beach break near the lighthouse. It's about an hour in the car, and it's smaller, about one meter, with an offshore wind until ten. Perfect. We need rides. Jess's dad has a van, but it isn't big enough for everybody and all the boards, so we need one more car. If your mum or dad can drive, tell me tonight. Meet at the school parking lot at half past five. Not six. Half past five. And bring enough water and food for the whole morning, because there's no shop there. Nothing. See you Saturday.

Hi love, it's Bev. I got your message about Saturday. So, yes, you can go, but I have three conditions. First, you're not old enough to drive, and neither are your mates, so an adult drives. Jess's dad is fine. Second, Kai says the waves are small enough, and I believe him, but you are not surfing on your own. Ever. Stay close to the group. The currents on that coast are strong, and you don't know the beach well enough yet. And third, it's winter here, love. The water is colder than you think. Take your long wetsuit, and a warm jacket for after. You were too cold on Tuesday and you didn't say anything. I saw your lips. They were blue. Right. Have fun.
